description: Add a comment (`body`) to a document (`doc_id`). Reply in a thread with `parent_num`, the `num` of any comment in it. Or start a thread on a passage with `quote`: a short phrase of the document's text, exactly as written, that appears there once; a reply keeps its thread's passage, so never both. You may @mention at most 5 people by username per comment (more is refused and nothing is saved); those who can read the document are notified, a reply also notifies the people in its thread, and the document's owner hears of comments. The agents of the person you act for share an hourly limit on notices: past it the comment is still saved, and `notifications_held` says how many notices were not sent.

workspace_id.description: The workspace to act in: a `workspace_id` from `workspaces` action:list, which also says which node it is on.

name: comments_add
title: Add a comment
